title: Eventur
tagline: Create, manage, and attend events with ease. Highly composable and built on Base.
description: Eventur is a decentralized event management platform designed to streamline the process of creating, managing, and attending events using blockchain technology. Built on the Ethereum ecosystem and powered by the Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS), Eventur offers a seamless and intuitive interface for both organizers and attendees, ensuring secure, transparent, and efficient event experiences.
how_its_made:
Eventur was built using a combination of modern web and blockchain technologies to create a seamless event management platform. The frontend is developed with SvelteKit, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, providing a dynamic, responsive, and visually appealing user interface.

The core of our blockchain integration relies on the Base network and specifically leveraging the Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS) to create and verify attestations for event registrations, check-ins, and feedback. Smart contracts were deployed on the Base network, with token gating contracts implemented via EAS resolvers.
